all_cancer.means: Every Europe PMC record matching cancer. The denominator.

in_pmc_oa.means: In Europe PMC's open-access subset. This is the figure MISSION.md quoted.

readable.means: Europe PMC holds the full text. Free to read; says nothing about reuse.

open_licence.query: cancer AND (LICENSE:cc0 OR LICENSE:'cc by' OR LICENSE:'cc-by' OR LICENSE:'cc by-sa' OR LICENSE:'public domain')
open_licence.means: Carries a licence permitting redistribution with attribution.

open_licence_not_oa_flagged.query: cancer AND (LICENSE:'cc by' OR LICENSE:'cc-by' OR LICENSE:cc0) AND OPEN_ACCESS:N
open_licence_not_oa_flagged.means: Openly licensed BUT flagged OPEN_ACCESS:N -- collectable, and invisible to any filter that trusts the flag alone.

readable_not_in_pmc_oa.means: Readable in Europe PMC yet outside the OA subset. The concrete counterexample to 'the remainder is paywalled'.
